evidence.scope: Uncalibrated contact-population, pressure-time and cohesive-opening diagnostics; not material tests, DEM, ski response or success probability.

machine.note: Inherited hypothetical 1km machine; 20,000m2 course differs from the 2,000m2 material-cost comparison. Nominal pressure assumes uniform load on the stated patch; not actual granular contacts.

kinetics.note: t90 is an assumed 90% conversion time of eligible contacts, not published tensile-strength recovery or project success rate. Null separation time denotes no contact loss. Bonded contacts are assumed stable during rest; no force, wetting, fatigue, aging or fracture feedback.

time_scales.note: Maxwell comparison only. Healing time and bulk relaxation need not be equal.

patch_coverage.note: Independent random coating contacts: eligible=f^2. Locally tree-like connectivity factor (z-1)*f^2*h; not a rigidity or real-grain percolation proof.

cohesive.note: Triangular normal traction-opening law. Gc and strength are independent hypothetical inputs, not from any candidate or snow. Normal separation is not ski shear friction.

cost.note: Hypothetical pretax costs, fixed polymer occupied volume. No procurement quote. Processing per kg of complete product; extra regeneration/civil cost excluded. 2% purchased replacement is not environmental discharge permission. Equipment cap JPY200M tax-inclusive separate.
